title: Formation of nanocluster {Dy12} containing Dy-exclusive vertex-sharing [Dy4(μ3-OH)4] cubanes via simultaneous multitemplate guided and step-by-step assembly

synthesis.procedure: HL (quinoline-2-carboxylic acid, 0.5 mmol, 0.0866 g) and DyCl3·6H2O (0.5 mmol, 0.1825 g) were placed in a 10 mL polytetrafluoroethylene reactor with 5 mL methanol and 5 mL acetonitrile and stirred. Three drops of triethylamine were added within 5 min. The vessel was heated at 80 °C for 48 h, then cooled to room temperature to give unsolvated transparent crystals.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, yielding unsolvated transparent crystals

properties.summary: Dy12 shows field-induced single-molecule magnet behaviour. χmT at room temperature is 168.24 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 170.04 for 12 uncoupled Dy(III)), remaining nearly constant to ~50 K then falling to 146.70 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization reaches 63.03 Nβ at 2 K and 7 T and M vs H/T curves do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. Weak out-of-phase ac response under zero dc field (9–997 Hz); under 2000 Oe a frequency- and temperature-dependent χ″ appears. Cole–Cole fits follow a single-relaxation Debye model with α = 0.2–0.6; Arrhenius parameters Ueff = 5.69(1) K and τ0 = 1.3(1)×10−5 s.
